newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares down, seen slipping further.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares down, seen slipping further.

text.p: Slovenian shares closed 1.36 percent lower on Friday as foreign buyers remained sidelined and traders said the market could shed another two to five percent in the medium term.
"Banks are expected to set up special trading accounts for international buyers in two to three weeks. Until then shares may slowly decline," one trader said.
The central bank last week said international investors had to open the accounts if they wanted to trade Slovenian securities.
* The 11-share SBI index fell 19.03 points to 1,385.03.
* Bank SKB was the most active share, falling 3.40 percent to 56,900 tolars on volume of 1,184 shares.
* Overall eight shares fell, six rose and four were unchanged, while seven were untraded. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
